nom: Elizabeth Arden Advanced Ceramide Capsules Daily Youth Restoring Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one dealing with severe winter dryness, report the serum keeps their skin soft, moisturized and glowy without feeling greasy or sticky.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or redness and say it works well on sensitive skin, though one reviewer describes purging and irritation on the forehead and around the mouth caused by the product's strength.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin, including a 76-year-old who has used the product for fifty years and one who bought it for her mother, report a smoother, younger-looking complexion.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and firmness report visibly plumper, firmer skin with consistent use, including when applied to the neck; a couple of reviewers say the plumping effect was weaker than expected or that they noticed no improvement in plumpness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as deeply hydrating, leaving skin soft, moisturized and glowy without greasiness, including through winter dryness; a few reviewers say it sat on top of their skin without deeply moisturizing or noticed no real improvement in hydration.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation, redness or breakouts, and some say it calmed irritation left by retinA treatment; one reviewer had a severe reaction with facial swelling and puffiness under the eyes, and another with sensitive skin experienced irritation and purging around the mouth and forehead.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the ceramide and peptide formula with nourishing and strengthening the skin barrier, with one reporting visible barrier repair alongside anti-aging benefits.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts, including one who saw pores diminish and another who says it did not break her out the way other products had; one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced purging around the mouth and forehead.
concerns.spots: The few reviewers who mention spots report none appeared with regular use.

extraits.texte: I got this for free as a Bday gift at Ulta. I used this and it caused a horrible puffiness on my face and swelling under my eyes. I have never had a reaction to using any product. After several days my face puffiness went down but the lines under my eyes remain. It has added about 15 years to my face. I am devastated.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love the packaging and the individual capsules help me to use the right amount and feel very luxurious. The texture is thick enough to spread, but it is a little difficult to get it all out of the capsule. My only complaint is that my skin seemed to be too sensitive for the strength of this product and I had some irritation and purging on my forehead and around my mouth.

This serum had a fun packaging as every little dose is wrapped separately, but all I kept thinking how that's not very environment friendly. The serum itself didn't do much difference for my skin. The texture is lightweight but feels like it just sits on top of the skin instead of deeply moisturizing it. I've used it for over a month and didn't feel like my skin was much different after applying the serum. The scent is super mild that's a plus for me

Super awesome product would definitely recommend this. Very effectiveness on my dry skin. The dosage I use is one capsule in the morning and one capsule before bed depending upon how dry my skin is. I store it in my bathroom cupboard where it is cool and dry. Very oily at first until my skin soaks all it's goodness up than it leaves my skin glowing. Awesome! Awesome! Awesome!

It is also very convenient for you to take with you on the go. The product is lightweight and not greasy at all. It absorbs quickly into the skin and I definitely noticed barrier repair and healing as well as skin noticeably more plump. Within a few weeks I saw my dry skin lines heal and disappear. My skin looked firmer and bright within a week of use. It also layers well with makeup.
